entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this helmet I bought. This is absolutely unacceptable and I want my money back immediately.
I'm sorry to hear there's an issue with your order. I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
It's VF98765. And don't waste my time. I expect this to be handled now, or I want to speak to a manager.
Thank you, I'm pulling that up. I see the Aero-Dynamic Helmet, delivered seven days ago. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's the color! The website showed a vibrant red, and this thing is a dull, ugly maroon. It's false advertising! The box is still unopened, I haven't even touched it.
I see. I apologize that the color wasn't what you expected. I want to confirm, aside from the color, you're not concerned about the fit or any of the helmet's safety features, correct?

How would I know? I just told you the box is unopened! Are you even listening to me? This is the worst customer service I've ever experienced. If you don't start the return process this second, I'm plastering one-star reviews everywhere.

Sir, I can absolutely process this return for you. There's no problem at all. For an item like a helmet, you are unfortunately outside our 10-day return policy. We can definitely get that started for you right now.
Wait, really? You're just going to take it back? No hassle?

That's correct. Your satisfaction is important to us. Since the box is unopened and it's just a matter of the color not being right, I've just emailed a prepaid return label to you. Simply print it out, attach it to the shipping box, and drop it off at a shipping center.
Oh. Okay. I see the email... Well, that's better than I expected. Thank you.

You're very welcome. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, you'll see a full refund to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Was there anything else I could help you with today?
Glad I could help. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
